company.name: InterGlobe Aviation (IndiGo)
company.tag: India’s largest airline: flies passengers and cargo across India and abroad
products: International flights to the Middle East, Asia, Europe and beyond
Fare types: Saver, Flexi, UpFront, IndiGoStretch and IndiGoStretch+
Seat choice, extra baggage, meals, changes and other add-ons
IndiGo CarGo: carrying goods in passenger planes and freighters
IndiGo BluChip loyalty programme and co-branded credit cards
Ground handling at airports (Agile Airport Services)
company.productNote: What IndiGo sells, from its 2025–26 annual report: tickets, add-on services, cargo and loyalty, plus the two wholly owned subsidiaries the report lists. Pictures are taken from the annual report itself.
